current_official_findings.verified: Persistent Composite DTM 1m WCS endpoint is documented as WCS 2.0.1 and WCS is explicitly used for raw elevation pixels; ArcGIS Make WCS Layer is expected to populate Input WCS Coverage from the endpoint.
HMLR polygons are captured in British National Grid / EPSG:27700; converting BNG to WGS84 may shift some features by up to 15 metres, so native BNG is required for parcel/raster masking.
OS OpenData API operations require no API key and provide product/detail/download discovery routes; current content should be discovered rather than hard-coding historical files.
GET /products/{productId}/downloads supports fileName, format, subformat, area and redirect filters; TQ is an allowed area value; redirect requires exactly one matching download.
The API is intended for automated, current OpenData retrieval and can expose metadata and download links.
